criterion: An item is RELEVANT if it changes something concrete for this household's money, property, movement, or a stated interest, as a result of this meeting. Anticipated or indirect effects are marked BORDERLINE rather than counted, so the headline figures do not depend on debatable calls.
known_bias: The labeller also wrote the system under test. Borderline items are reported separately for exactly this reason, and every label carries its rationale so a specific call can be disputed without discarding the whole set.
